newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates Bank of Valletta l-term A minus.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates Bank of Valletta l-term A minus.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Friday it had assigned Bank of Valletta a long-term rating of A minus, a short-term rating of A2, an individual rating of B/C and a legal rating of 2.
"The ratings reflect Bank of Valletta's position as one of the two largest commercial banks operating in Malta," IBCA said in a statement.

"Bank of Valletta's profitabiltiy compares favourably internationally and its capitalisation is good. The bank has been actively implementing a strategy of expansion which has allowed Bank of Valletta to increase substantially its loan book, without significant deterioration in asset quality," the agency said.

"Although more foreign financial institutions are likely to enter the heavily protected Maltese market, IBCA believes that Bank of Valletta's extensive baranch network will permit it to withstand increased competition in its own franchise," IBCA said.
